title: Single-Token Detection of Jailbreaks: Replicating and Extending 'LLM Jailbreak Detection for (Almost) Free'

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: cheap always-on detection is a prerequisite for deployment safety. Understanding whether first-token detectors generalize to multi-turn and encoding attacks directly informs deployment decisions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: FJD is conceptually simple: check first-token confidence. Replication requires basic inference and confidence extraction. AISafetyLab provides attack implementations. Testing against new attack types is straightforward. Beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Replication on 2-3 models is tight. Extension to multi-turn and encoding attacks adds scope. False-positive measurement adds another dimension. Could be scoped to replication + one extension to fit 30 hours.
